name: code
description: code — coding-workflow plugin. Sub-skills for the manager/router engineering loop: `code:loop` drains a queue end-to-end (single ticket or many) with mindset-grounded autonomy and inline verification, `code:review` is one skill with three modes — session PRs by default, a deep cold review given PR number(s) (file:line grounding, architecture rubric, security pass), or a read-only whole-repo architecture-and-quality scan given `repo`/a path/`--since` — `code:learn` learns a codebase and writes durable navigation notes into the project's own AGENTS.md, folding a genuine coding-workflow lesson back into the plugin only secondarily. `/commit` splits the working tree into the maximum number of small logical commits. Ships the `code-reviewer` subagent that `code:review` spawns: an adversarial non-author reviewer that refutes its own candidate findings before reporting, so every finding carries a file:line quote and a concrete failure scenario. Publishing a distributable lives at the top-level `/release` command, not in this plugin.
